column1: # The short-body band: 4-8 line pairs, against a rails checkout. Same grammar
# as pairs.tsv; kept apart so the near tier's documented limitation — jaccard
# is harsher on short bodies, where one edit moves a third of the tokens —
# gets a measured miss-rate instead of a paragraph. No harness reads this file
# yet; run it by pointing `contour eval` at a directory holding it as
# pairs.tsv (see tests/eval/README.md).
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER. Every verdict verified by
# reading both bodies against DEC-020. Measured jaccard noted per row; the
# threshold is 0.80.
# One guard line differs between the sibling classes whose #count is already
# an exact duplicate (see pairs.tsv). 7 lines, 0.71.
ActiveRecord::InternalMetadata#drop_table
# Copied test scaffold; the tweak is which hook it drives (0.75).
ActionCable::Connection::MultipleIdentifiersTest#open_connection
# Copied test; one literal differs (0.67).
ModelGeneratorTest#test_check_class_collision
# REXMLEngineTest re-states the shared EngineTests case with only the fixture
# string changed (0.60).
XMLMiniEngineTest::EngineTests#test_parse_from_frozen_string
# Copied test, one association call differs; a shared example would hold both
HasManyAssociationsTest#test_association_attributes_are_available_to_after_initialize
# --- distinct: same shape, the difference IS the behaviour -------------------
# Dialect SQL: " IS NOT DISTINCT FROM " against " <=> " (0.60).
Arel::Visitors::PostgreSQL#visit_Arel_Nodes_IsNotDistinctFrom
# Service-specific headers are the entire point of each override (0.64).
ActiveStorage::Service::S3Service#headers_for_direct_upload
# The test double skips the real session's lazy load; merging them would put
# test behaviour in production (0.56).
ActionController::TestSession#dig
# MySQL's extra null-check is adapter semantics; the visitor hierarchy exists
# so the adapters can differ (0.76 — the closest distinct pair to the
# threshold in this band).
ActiveRecord::ConnectionAdapters::MySQL::SchemaCreation#visit_ChangeColumnDefaultDefinition
# Copied then adapted, but the assertion tests a different association type —
# consolidating would erase the distinction under test (0.69).
HasOneThroughAssociationsTest#test_loading_cpk_association_with_unpersisted_owner
